Im Auftrag unseres Partnerunternehmens aus dem Öffentlichen Dienst in Aachen suchen wir Sie zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als „Projektcontroller (m/w/d)".

Aufgaben

  • Als Projektcontroller (m/w/d) planen, kalkulieren und überwachen Sie Budgets für unterschiedliche Projekte und behalten deren wirtschaftliche Entwicklung im Blick

Qualifikation

  • Zusätzlich wenden Sie MS Office insbesondere Excel sicher an, erste Kenntnisse in SAP sind von Vorteil und Sie verfügen über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Wichtig sind eine sorgfältige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie Kommunikationsstärke, Teamfähigkeit und Serviceorientierung

Benefits

  • Work-Life-Balance: Freuen Sie sich auf flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie anteilige Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten
  • Sicherheit: Kaum eine Branche bietet eine Sicherheit wie der Öffentliche Dienst

  • Gesundheit: Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, Sportangebot und hauseigene Kantine mit täglich frischen Gerichten

cards.announcement: Wir - die HvS-Consulting GmbH – sind Spezialisten für Cyber Security und davon überzeugt, dass die Werte unserer Gesellschaft auch im Cyber-Raum geschützt werden müssen. Deshalb helfen wir Organisationen, sich mit dem richtigen Zusammenspiel aus Technologien, Prozessen und Menschen selbst zu schützen. Unser Motto lautet „People – Process – Technology" Für unser Team in Garching bei München suchen wir ab sofort eine(n) Senior Incident Responder (m/w/d) Aufgaben Das erwartet Dich: Incident Response : Du betreust komplexe Cyber Security Incidents bei unseren Kunden und begleitest die First Response, Analyse, Eindämmung, Aufarbeitung und Wiederherstellung Incident-Leitung : Du steuerst Sicherheitsvorfälle, koordinierst alle beteiligten Parteien und sorgst für eine strukturierte, zielorientierte und verlässliche Bearbeitung. Dabei bildest Du die Schnittstelle zwischen den technischen Workstreams und der Entscheider-Ebene, beispielsweise dem Krisenstab oder dem Management. Du kommunizierst sicher mit technischen Ansprechpartnern sowie dem Management und steuerst das Incident Response Team Security Consulting : Du berätst unsere Kunden vor und nach Sicherheitsvorfällen ganzheitlich, um die Strategie, die technische Architektur, Prozesse und Skills des Cyber Defense Centers weiterzuentwickeln Threat Landscape : Gemeinsam mit deinem Team behältst Du die aktuelle Bedrohungslage im Blick. Du informierst unsere Kunden auf technischer und Management-Ebene über relevante Bedrohungen und gibst konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen Technische Schulungen : Du konzipierst und hältst Schulungen, Workshops, Trainings und Übungen rund um Incident Response, Digitaler Forensik und CDC Service Management : Du verantwortest die Qualität und Weiterentwicklung unserer Incident-Response-Services und setzt neue Ideen konsequent um Konzepte und Prozesse: Du entwickelst unsere Incident-Response-Konzepte, Prozesse und Standards kontinuierlich weiter und etablierst praxistaugliche Strukturen Qualifikation Das bringst Du mit: Führungserfahrung : Du bringst mehrjährige Führungserfahrung mit und hast bereits ein Team fachlich und disziplinarisch geleitet Incident Response : Du verfügst über fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Bearbeitung und Koordination komplexer Cyber Security Incidents Threat Landscape : Du kennst die aktuelle Bedrohungslage und verstehst relevante Threat Actors, Angreifertechniken und Angriffsmuster, beispielsweise bei APT-Angriffen, Ransomware, Innentätern oder Supply-Chain-Angriffen Technische Expertise : Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Security-Technologien wie SIEM, EDR und NDR Consulting-Erfahrung : Du bist mit der Beratung von Kunden vertraut und vermittelst technische Sachverhalte klar und adressatengerecht und agierst sicher als Schnittstelle zwischen technischen Workstreams, Krisenstab und Management Schulungserfahrung : Du hast Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Durchführung technischer Schulungen, Workshops oder Übungen Prozesse und Services : Du hast Security-Incident-Management-Prozesse, fachliche Konzepte oder Cyber Security Services entwickelt und erfolgreich weitergeführt KI und Innovation : Du hast Erfahrung in der Integration von KI oder Large Language Models in DFIR-Services oder vergleichbare Tätigkeiten Service Management : Du weißt, wie professionelle Cyber Security Services gesteuert, bewertet und weiterentwickelt werden. Ebenfalls hast Du bereits die potentiale von KI/LLM erkannt und hast diese in Cyber Security Services oder Tätigkeiten integriert Führungspersönlichkeit : Du führst klar und verbindlich, kannst Menschen motivieren und gehst empathisch auf unterschiedliche Persönlichkeiten ein Gestaltungswille : Du bringst neue Ideen und strategischen Weitblick ein, übernimmst Verantwortung und setzt Veränderungen konsequent um Qualifikation : Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung, sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und rund 20 Prozent Reisebereitschaft (DACH-Raum) Benefits Was dich aber vor allem erwartet: Ein abwechslungsreicher und vielseitiger Job in einem der (aus unserer Sicht) spannendsten Themengebiete überhaupt. Und das in einem Unternehmen, in dem wirklich jede Meinung gehört und geschätzt wird – vom Praktikanten bis zur Geschäftsführung. Uns gibt dieser Job nicht nur ein Gehalt, sondern auch persönliche Zufriedenheit, weil wir wirklich etwas bewirken und die Welt ein Stück sicherer machen. Bei uns gibt es (natürlich) kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und Snacks, aber das ist heutzutage Standard. Zusätzlich bieten wir auf Wunsch attraktive Benefits, von Jobticket bis hin zu Kindergartenzuschuss. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten helfen Dir, auch auf Unvorhergesehenes im Alltag gelassen zu reagieren. Schau dir unsere Benefits gerne auf unserer Karriereseite genauer an. Was erwartet Dich noch? Wir pflegen eine offene, vertrauensvolle Unternehmenskultur (schau mal auf Kununu ) und schätzen eigenständiges Arbeiten, natürlich auch, aber nicht nur im Home-Office. Schließlich haben wir ein modernes Büro in Garching mit sensationellem Alpenblick, in dem wir gerne gemeinsam Mittagsessen und uns mit unseren Security-Auditoren, Incident-Respondern, Awareness-Trainern und Multimedia-Designern austauschen. Dabei bildest Du die Schnittstelle zwischen den technischen Workstreams und der Entscheider-Ebene, beispielsweise dem Krisenstab oder dem Management. Du kommunizierst sicher mit technischen Ansprechpartnern sowie dem Management und steuerst das Incident Response Team
  • Security Consulting: Du berätst unsere Kunden vor und nach Sicherheitsvorfällen ganzheitlich, um die Strategie, die technische Architektur, Prozesse und Skills des Cyber Defense Centers weiterzuentwickeln
  • Threat Landscape: Gemeinsam mit deinem Team behältst Du die aktuelle Bedrohungslage im Blick. Du informierst unsere Kunden auf technischer und Management-Ebene über relevante Bedrohungen und gibst konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen
  • Technische Schulungen: Du konzipierst und hältst Schulungen, Workshops, Trainings und Übungen rund um Incident Response, Digitaler Forensik und CDC
  • Service Management: Du verantwortest die Qualität und Weiterentwicklung unserer Incident-Response-Services und setzt neue Ideen konsequent um
  • Konzepte und Prozesse: Du entwickelst unsere Incident-Response-Konzepte, Prozesse und Standards kontinuierlich weiter und etablierst praxistaugliche Strukturen

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Führungserfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Führungserfahrung mit und hast bereits ein Team fachlich und disziplinarisch geleitet
  • Incident Response: Du verfügst über fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Bearbeitung und Koordination komplexer Cyber Security Incidents
  • Threat Landscape: Du kennst die aktuelle Bedrohungslage und verstehst relevante Threat Actors, Angreifertechniken und Angriffsmuster, beispielsweise bei APT-Angriffen, Ransomware, Innentätern oder Supply-Chain-Angriffen
  • Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Security-Technologien wie SIEM, EDR und NDR
  • Consulting-Erfahrung: Du bist mit der Beratung von Kunden vertraut und vermittelst technische Sachverhalte klar und adressatengerecht und agierst sicher als Schnittstelle zwischen technischen Workstreams, Krisenstab und Management
  • Schulungserfahrung: Du hast Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Durchführung technischer Schulungen, Workshops oder Übungen
  • Prozesse und Services: Du hast Security-Incident-Management-Prozesse, fachliche Konzepte oder Cyber Security Services entwickelt und erfolgreich weitergeführt
  • KI und Innovation: Du hast Erfahrung in der Integration von KI oder Large Language Models in DFIR-Services oder vergleichbare Tätigkeiten
  • Service Management: Du weißt, wie professionelle Cyber Security Services gesteuert, bewertet und weiterentwickelt werden. Ebenfalls hast Du bereits die potentiale von KI/LLM erkannt und hast diese in Cyber Security Services oder Tätigkeiten integriert
  • Führungspersönlichkeit: Du führst klar und verbindlich, kannst Menschen motivieren und gehst empathisch auf unterschiedliche Persönlichkeiten ein
  • Gestaltungswille: Du bringst neue Ideen und strategischen Weitblick ein, übernimmst Verantwortung und setzt Veränderungen konsequent um
  • Qualifikation: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung, sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und rund 20 Prozent Reisebereitschaft (DACH-Raum)

Benefits

Was dich aber vor allem erwartet:

Ein abwechslungsreicher und vielseitiger Job in einem der (aus unserer Sicht) spannendsten Themengebiete überhaupt. Und das in einem Unternehmen, in dem wirklich jede Meinung gehört und geschätzt wird – vom Praktikanten bis zur Geschäftsführung. Uns gibt dieser Job nicht nur ein Gehalt, sondern auch persönliche Zufriedenheit, weil wir wirklich etwas bewirken und die Welt ein Stück sicherer machen.

Bei uns gibt es (natürlich) kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und Snacks, aber das ist heutzutage Standard. Zusätzlich bieten wir auf Wunsch attraktive Benefits, von Jobticket bis hin zu Kindergartenzuschuss. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten helfen Dir, auch auf Unvorhergesehenes im Alltag gelassen zu reagieren. Schau dir unsere Benefits gerne auf unserer Karriereseite genauer an.

Was erwartet Dich noch? Wir pflegen eine offene, vertrauensvolle Unternehmenskultur (schau mal auf Kununu) und schätzen eigenständiges Arbeiten, natürlich auch, aber nicht nur im Home-Office. Schließlich haben wir ein modernes Büro in Garching mit sensationellem Alpenblick, in dem wir gerne gemeinsam Mittagsessen und uns mit unseren Security-Auditoren, Incident-Respondern, Awareness-Trainern und Multimedia-Designern austauschen.

At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc).

Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action.

Tasks

Your mission

We are looking for a Tech Lead to join our engineering team. This role requires an ambitious technical leader who can architect scalable systems, navigate complex carbon data architectures, and drive engineering excellence. Moving beyond traditional software delivery, you will translate product vision into reliable technology, lead critical architectural decisions, and leave a lasting mark on our platform from day one.

  • Architect and scale a seamless B2B procurement platform, delivering an intuitive, enterprise-grade user interface designed for daily engagement and complex workflows.
  • Drive end-to-end technical strategy, design, and architecture, translating ambitious product requirements into performant, scalable features and microservices.
  • Lead by example with hands-on technical execution, authoring high-quality, maintainable code across our TypeScript, Node.js, and Next.js stack.
  • Cultivate engineering excellence across the team, providing high-impact mentorship, technical guidance, and rigorous code reviews to continuously elevate development standards.
  • Safeguard platform integrity, establishing robust security, reliability, and performance standards across our applications and core cloud infrastructure.
  • Partner closely with product, design, and cross-functional teams, evaluating trade-offs and technical permutations to engineer optimal, user-centric solutions.

Requirements

What you need to succeed

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of technical leadership (2+ years) guiding teams through complex, full-lifecycle product deliveries.
  • Deep technical proficiency in TypeScript and the Node.js ecosystem, alongside extensive hands-on experience building modern, data-dense interfaces with React or Next.js.
  • Strong architectural expertise in RESTful API design, backend systems architecture, and relational data modelling (PostgreSQL experience preferred).
  • Demonstrated commitment to engineering rigour, with a deep understanding of software design patterns, enterprise web security standards, and modern development workflows (Git, feature branching).
  • Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure and continuous deployment, including hands-on experience building and maintaining services on platforms like AWS.
  • Exceptional collaborative and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical decisions, bridge alignment across product teams, and mentor engineers.
  • Basic familiarity with Python is a plus, or a strong technical curiosity to expand into auxiliary parts of our data processing stack.

Benefits

What's in it for you at CEEZER?

  • A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets.
  • Accelerated growth: We are scaling fast, and your career will too. Take opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives and expand your strategic influence.
  • True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it.
  • An empowering environment: We bring together diverse global perspectives, knowing that solving complex climate challenges requires a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.
  • Real enterprise impact: Transform how global corporates approach sustainability. CEEZER hosts 50Mt+ of vetted carbon credits across all pathways, all backed by sophisticated data and institutional-grade risk management.
  • A net-zero career: We practice what we preach. From your first day, we fully offset your personal and professional carbon footprint because sustainability is how we operate.

The hiring process

  • An intro call with the People Team
  • A Technical Interview with our SVP of Tech, Felipe
  • A Case Study with 2 Engineers from the team

Create an impact with us?

We know that great talent doesn’t always follow a linear path. If your experience doesn't check every single box on this list, but you have the drive and unique strengths to excel here, we still want to hear from you.

Here, building a diverse team isn't a checkbox—It’s how we solve complex global challenges. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, skills, and potential, while actively working to keep unconscious bias out of our process. We’ve created an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to succeed. We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone to thrive.

If you need any adjustments or specific accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We are here to support you.

cards.announcement: Werde Teil des Business Development Teams zur Förderung der neuen, innovativen apeiron-Plattform! Bei Ginmon arbeiten wir in einem Team aus jungen, visionären Experten daran, die Lücke zwischen wissenschaftlichem Portfoliomanagement und modernster Kapitalmarkttechnologie zu schließen. Mit unserer Plattform helfen wir Privatanleger:innen, ihre finanziellen Ziele durch ETF-basierte Anlagestrategien effizient und kostengünstig zu erreichen. Nach unserem Erfolg im B2C-Bereich markiert das Jahr 2026 einen Meilenstein: den offiziellen Start von apeiron Wealth ( www.apeiron-wealth.com ). Dabei handelt es sich um unser zukunftsweisendes, KI-natives Betriebssystem für Vermögensberater:innen, das eine hochmoderne, vollautomatisierte Infrastruktur bietet. Diese ermöglicht es Vermögensberater:innen, ihr gesamtes Beratungsgeschäft zu digitalisieren und die Qualität sowie die Tiefe der Kundenbetreuung erheblich zu steigern. Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Business Development Team unterstützt du uns bei der Vermarktung des Produkts apeiron und der Generierung neuer Leads. Dabei sammelst du praxisnahe Einblicke in den Aufbau eines wachsenden B2B-Geschäfts. Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis für unser Produkt apeiron und dessen Marktvorteile, um potenzielle Kund:innen kompetent beraten zu können. Du initiierst den Erstkontakt zu unabhängigen Finanzberater:innen über verschiedene Kanäle (Telefon, E-Mail, LinkedIn) und vermittelst dabei einen professionellen und positiven Eindruck von apeiron. Du vereinbarst Termine mit unserem Business-Development-Manager und unserem CEO und hilfst mit, unsere Strategie zur Produktvermarktung mitzugestalten. Du pflegst und aktualisierst CRM-Datensätze sorgfältig, um eine datengestützte Sales-Pipeline zu gewährleisten. Du setzt moderne KI-Tools wie Claude und Gemini sowie Prozessautomatisierung ein, um deine Arbeitsprozesse und die Effizienz im Business Development zu steigern. Du arbeitest in einem Team aus jungen, initiativen Menschen und bist dem Business Development Manager sowie dem CEO unterstellt. Dabei erwarten dich Perspektiven zur eigenständigen Übernahme von Aufgaben und Verantwortungsbereichen, die dir helfen, dich zum Business Development Manager weiterzuentwickeln. Dein Profil Du bist in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang, beispielsweise in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, BWL, Finanzen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit Schwerpunkt Kapitalmarkt, eingeschrieben und hast idealerweise noch mindestens ein Jahr Studium vor dir. Du bist kontaktfreudig, kommunikationsstark und trittst auch am Telefon sicher und professionell auf. Idealerweise bringst du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Kundenkontakt, im Vertrieb oder in der Beratung mit. Du begeisterst dich für innovative technologische Lösungen und KI und möchtest Arbeitsprozesse durch intelligente Tools maximal effizient gestalten. Du bist ein echter Teamplayer, kannst aber ebenso eigenständig agieren. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Leads und denkst proaktiv mit. Du kommunizierst auf Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (wichtig für die Kundenansprache) und verfügst über verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse. Du wohnst im Rhein-Main-Gebiet und arbeitest flexibel 16 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche in unserem Büro in Frankfurt am Main. Was wir bieten Die Möglichkeit, den Markterfolg von apeiron Wealth aktiv mitzugestalten und die digitale Transformation der deutschen Vermögensberatung direkt zu beeinflussen. Maßgebliche Möglichkeiten zum Weiterlernen durch Workshops mit erfahrenen Professionals sowie gezielten Kompetenzaufbau. Direktes Reporting an den Business Development Manager und den CEO sowie flache Hierarchien mit viel Raum für deine eigenen Ideen, perfekt, um wertvolle Business- und Vertriebserfahrung direkt vom Management zu sammeln. Ein internationales, junges und gleichgesinntes Team von Profis mit einer ausgeprägten "Get-things-done"-Mentalität und einer hervorragenden Arbeitsatmosphäre. Eine ausgewogene Balance zwischen Klausurenphase und Job dank flexibler Einteilung deiner 16 bis 20 Stunden. Spezielle Konditionen für Mitarbeiterinvestments, High-End-Equipment (auch für dein Studium nutzbar), regelmäßige Teamevents sowie eine moderne Büroatmosphäre inklusive Kaffeeflatrate, Snacks und Drinks. source_record.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

Most Product Manager roles are built around specs and handoffs, waiting on a designer's mockup, an engineer's sprint slot, a data analyst's report.

This role is built differently: we're hiring a PM who does more than decide what should be built. You'll steer a developer squad end to end: investigating opportunities, analyzing user behaviour, prototyping solutions with AI, contributing code, launching experiments, and improving what reaches production.

You'll work directly with Pierre Gerbaud, Product Lead, and Michael Monin, our Co-founder & CTO, on a product already used by more than 50 million people and growing toward 100 million users.

At this scale, every small improvement can create significant impact, and you'll have the space to spot these opportunities and act on them quickly.

If your first instinct is to test an idea by making it real, this is your role.

 

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the work end to end, not just a piece of it: Understand the problem, choose an approach, build the solution (AI-assisted coding, opening pull requests, working with internal tools), launch it, measure it, and iterate with as few handoffs as possible;

  • Build with AI every day: Use AI tools for research, analysis, prototyping, and debugging; as a genuine part of how you think and work, evolving with the tools as they improve;

  • Decide what's worth pursuing, and test it fast: When a dozen directions look plausible and there are more ideas than time, identify the opportunities that matter most and design the smallest meaningful experiment to test your assumptions;

  • Let the results determine what happens next: Define success before you build, analyse the outcome once the experiment is live, and use what you learn to improve, expand, or stop what you shipped;

  • Work embedded in a software engineering squad: partner directly with Leads, Co-founders, designers, and engineers to define and deliver priority projects, and communicate progress and decisions to all relevant stakeholders;

  • Keep momentum high: Surface blockers the moment they appear, challenge assumptions directly regardless of who made them, and find another route forward when the obvious one is blocked;

 

Your Qualifications

  • You build with AI: you’ve personally built and shipped a functional feature, experiment, prototype, workflow, or tool using AI coding tools. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar tools are already part of how you work everyday;

  • You use data to make product decisions: you can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next;

  • You explore AI independently: you actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them;

  • You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process;

  • You communicate clearly and collaborate directly: you work effectively with designers, engineers, and other stakeholders, ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent in English;

  • You care about the user experience: you take pride in the quality of what reaches users, and pay attention to whether the product is useful, intuitive, and engaging;

  • You are comfortable with the product category: you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content;

Bonus points

  • You have enough design fluency to prompt a usable UI independently

  • You’ve worked at a fast-scaling D2C/consumer tech company or scale-up

  • You have experience on consumer-facing features

  • You have experience in Entertainment, Avatars, Gaming, or any high-touch media industry

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Cursor, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

* 💸 Compensation: Our salary ranges are set based on role level, scope, location, and market data, and applied consistently regardless of candidate background or negotiation history. The final offer within the published range reflects assessed experience and scope.

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Compensation: €75K – €125K

cards.announcement: Job Description As Platform QA Chapter Lead on the Platform side at JustPlay, you’ll lead and scale quality assurance for our core app experience — the foundation that powers our games, live operations, and player rewards. Working closely with Engineering, you’ll ensure the platform runs seamlessly across devices, regions, and releases, setting the standard for quality, reliability, and user experience. You'll split your time between hands-on QA work and leading the QA engineers in the QA chapter: helping them grow in their craft, spreading good practice, and raising the bar for quality across the teams you work with. A key part of this role will be driving smarter, more scalable testing approaches, including AI-driven testing and automation. Job Responsibilities Own the full QA lifecycle for JustPlay’s app and platform features — from test planning and execution to reporting and defect management. Foster a strong quality culture across teams by embedding QA best practices early and tying quality goals to product velocity and platform reliability. Drive innovation through AI-driven testing and predictive approaches to identify risks earlier, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort. Partner with development, design, and product teams to integrate QA best practices early in the release cycle. Design and maintain comprehensive test plans and automated suites for key user flows (login, payments, live events, notifications, etc.). Lead, mentor, and scale the QA team — setting up clear processes, code quality standards, and testing frameworks. Implement automation and regression testing strategies using tools such as Maestro, Espresso, XCTest, Appium, or similar frameworks. Use contract testing (e.g., Pact) to validate backend and service integrations. Apply performance and reliability testing across mobile platforms to ensure smooth user experiences. Job Requirements 5+ years of experience in QA for mobile apps or platforms, including at least 2 years leading teams. Proven ability to design scalable QA processes in fast-paced, development-heavy environments. Strong experience with automation frameworks, regression testing, and CI/CD pipelines. Hands-on experience with mobile debugging tools (Android Studio, Xcode) and network analysis tools like Charles. Strong understanding of how to build a quality-first mindset across engineering and product teams. Interest in or experience with AI-assisted testing and new QA technologies. Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a user-first mindset. Familiarity with project and documentation tools such as Jira and Notion. Nice to have Experience in backend integration testing and API monitoring. Experience with contract testing frameworks such as Pact. Job Benefits Work-Life Balance and Flexibility : Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers Mental Health Support : Free personal coaching through our partner nilo.health to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work Training & Development : A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply Germany-Based Benefits : 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution State-of-the-Art Equipment : Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed A Relocation Package : Includes visa support for those who need it Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations Berlin Office Perks : Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment. Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer. About us Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell. Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse. With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype. Du bist der/die souveräne Ansprechpartner:in für Beiräte, während unsere Struktur dir den administrativen Wahnsinn abnimmt: Support: Ein Customer Success Team beantwortet Tickets und Standard-Anfragen für dich. Technik: Ein Instandhaltungs-Team übernimmt die Handwerker-Koordination. Backoffice: Ein Buchhaltungs-Team hält die Zahlen und Abrechnungen sauber. cards.announcement: Who We Are Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products! As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as the (Senior) Web Analyst (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. What Will Your Role Be We're looking for a Senior Web Analyst to own and evolve our digital measurement ecosystem. You'll help us understand how millions of users interact with our digital products and turn that understanding into better product and business decisions.You'll work at the intersection of Product, Marketing and Engineering, ensuring that our tracking is accurate, scalable and future-proof. From defining measurement strategies to implementing tracking solutions and uncovering actionable insights, you'll play a key role in improving our digital products and customer experience. This is not a generic Data Analytics or Data Science role. We're looking for someone with a strong background in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics or Product Analytics who enjoys solving real business problems through reliable data. What You´ll Do Own Digital Measurement Own and continuously improve our digital measurement landscape across multiple digital products. Design, implement and optimise client-side and server-side tracking solutions. Ensure accurate, scalable and privacy-compliant data collection. Drive Measurement Strategy Translate business questions into measurement concepts and technical tracking requirements. Define KPIs and success metrics together with Product, Marketing and business stakeholders. Develop tracking specifications for new products, features and customer journeys. Generate Insights Analyse user behaviour, customer journeys and conversion funnels. Build dashboards and reporting solutions that enable data-informed decision making. Identify optimisation opportunities and provide actionable recommendations. Experiment and Optimise Design, implement and evaluate A/B tests and experimentation initiatives. Measure the impact of new features, campaigns and product improvements. Continuously improve tracking quality, measurement standards and analytics processes. Collaborate Across Teams Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and Marketing teams. Present analytical findings in a clear and actionable way to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Help establish analytics best practices across the organisation. What You´ll Bring Several years of experience in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics or Product Analytics. Hands-on experience with modern tracking implementations and digital measurement architectures. Practical experience with tag management systems such as Adobe Experience Platform Tags or Google Tag Manager. Experience with Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics 4 or comparable enterprise analytics platforms. Solid knowledge of JavaScript and experience with SQL and/or Python. cards.announcement: Coding agents are only as good as the context they're given. Most explore a repository like a new hire on day one – grepping, opening files, guessing. JetBrains Context replaces that with actual knowledge of your whole codebase and resources, served to any agent that asks. If you want to own the layer that decides what an agent knows before it writes a single line, this is for you. About JetBrains We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale. What you’ll do As agents get better at searching for themselves, what is the durable value of a managed retrieval layer? We need someone with an opinionated answer to own JetBrains Context as a product – defining what it is for, who it is for, how we measure success, and where it goes next. This is a hands-on role where you'll manage the product from a terminal and agent session rather than slides. You'll bridge the technical core and cross-functional teams: collaborating closely with engineering and ML teams on indexing pipelines and retrieval quality, working with Air, IDE, and Junie teams on integrations, and partnering with marketing, developer advocacy, sales, and customer success on positioning and adoption. You'll take full ownership of defining problem statements, setting explicit trade-offs, and balancing cost, latency, and freshness across the platform. Day to day, you will: Build and maintain a deep working understanding of chunking, embeddings, index freshness, retrieval, reranking, and agent-facing surfaces. Define and defend an opinionated vision for the product's evolution, including explicit target audiences, use cases, and key success metrics. Translate product strategy into actionable problem statements, priorities, plans, and milestones with an explicit definition of “done”. Communicate product direction clearly to engineering, leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, customers, and prospects. Analyze competing context and code-search products through direct use to establish clear differentiators and identify gaps. Define core operational and product metrics – index freshness, retrieval quality, agent task outcomes, adoption, retention, and unit economics – to guide decision-making. Represent the product externally by sharing roadmaps, publishing updates, speaking to developer audiences, and gathering community feedback. Partner with ML teams on model evaluation and platform teams on service scale, reliability, and cost. What you’ll bring A well-argued point of view on where AI-first development is going and what agents genuinely need from a context layer. Comfort with technical depth across embeddings, retrieval quality, sub-agents, tool-calling, indexing costs, and API design. The habit of using the product you build daily alongside competitors' tools. Communication that adapts to different audiences, from staff engineers and enterprise architects to conference attendees. A data-informed approach that combines telemetry, evaluation results, customer conversations, and market signals. Comfort with ambiguity and a preference for defining a new category over copying an existing one. What you’ll need Proven experience owning a complex developer, platform, or infrastructure product end to end, including strategy and roadmap. Hands-on familiarity with modern AI coding tools and agent workflows. The technical capability to work directly with engineering on retrieval behavior, APIs, data models, and integration surfaces. The ability to define metrics for quality-sensitive products and build evaluation habits that maintain product standards. Experience communicating a product externally through written content, talks, or community engagement. Practical experience with search, retrieval, RAG, developer search, or static analysis at scale is a plus. What success looks like Within your first months, you'll form and share a clear thesis for what JetBrains Context is and is not – one the engineering team recognizes as theirs and leadership can invest in. You'll establish a metrics story that distinguishes real retrieval quality from vanity usage, a roadmap with clear trade-offs, and a documented evaluation of serious competitors. Longer term, success means JetBrains Context becomes a deliberate choice for developers and organizations, agents get measurably better answers because it exists, enterprises adopt it for its governance and scale, and the market clearly understands its unique value because you've communicated it effectively. Why join JetBrains?  Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience. Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office. Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad. Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love. Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes. Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills. Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays. Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services. Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend. Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings. *Some benefits may vary depending on location. #LI-HYBRID - if you  want LinkedIn to post your role as hybrid in all the locations where the role is open ---> leave this tag in JD #LI-AA1  We are an equal opportunity employer We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. cards.announcement: What is Flagstone? Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work. Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage. A feel for our culture: To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth. That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it. We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three. But enough about us. Let’s talk about you. Does this sound like you? You're a passionate and experienced Staff Engineer specialising in front-end and mobile, who's excited to forge a new way to save! You set the technical bar for React and React Native across a tribe of squads, drive cross-team initiatives, and act as a force multiplier - coaching engineers, shaping architecture, and representing Flagstone in the wider engineering community. What you’ll do: The Staff Engineer will take a leading role in driving front-end and mobile technical strategy across a tribe of 3–5 squads, ensuring the delivery of high-quality systems that meet our business objectives. You'll partner with squads, Engineering Team Leads, and Product to identify how technology can solve business challenges and take a long-term view on company value. You'll also play a crucial role in mentoring and coaching engineers, helping them grow their system design skills and ship robust, scalable solutions. As a technical leader, you'll provide strategic guidance while also contributing hands-on to key projects. This will focus on: Technical Strategy: Set the front-end and mobile technical vision in collaboration with Engineering Team Leads, aligning with wider business objectives. Cross-Squad Leadership: Originate and lead horizontal engineering initiatives across the tribe; author and shepherd RFCs from proposal to adoption. Solution Delivery: Contribute directly to building and maintaining high-quality React and React Native systems while supporting and unblocking other engineers. Architecture & Design: Own cross-platform architecture decisions for web and mobile (React, React Native, TypeScript), ensuring scalable, reliable, and efficient design with a forward-looking approach. Design Systems: Lead the evolution of our shared design system across web and mobile, driving consistency, accessibility, and developer velocity across squads. Mentorship & Multiplier Impact: Coach engineers in system design, coding standards, and testing; start initiatives that others complete; delegate to protect bandwidth for the highest-leverage work. Communities of Practice: Drive adoption of front-end and mobile engineering practices through CoP leadership and engagement across the tribe. Horizon Scanning: Identify emerging front-end and mobile technologies, build proof-of-concepts, and create roadmaps for adoption. Operational Excellence: Champion the "you build it, you run it" philosophy - driving pipeline observability, zero-downtime deployments, robust monitoring, and alerting for front-end applications. Resilience & Performance: Design solution-wide UI resilience (graceful degradation, back-pressure, retry strategies) and own performance standards across web and mobile. Quality, Security & Compliance: Own threat modelling and security hardening for tribe front-end products; maintain high standards through code review, secure coding practices, and risk management. External Representation: Represent Flagstone externally through conference talks, podcasts, or published content; help attract senior engineering talent through your network and reputation. Collaboration: Work closely with Product Managers, designers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to align technical decisions with business needs. What you’ll bring: Proven experience in a Staff Engineer (or equivalent) role with a front-end and mobile focus. Deep expertise in React and React Native with TypeScript , including cross-platform architecture. Track record of owning and evolving a design system used across web and mobile applications. Strong system architecture and design skills, with thorough understanding of SOLID principles, TDD, DDD, and software design patterns . Experience designing for resilience and performance at scale (graceful degradation, zero-downtime deployments, observability, performance budgets). Experience with Azure development and cloud-based infrastructure , including CI/CD and pipeline observability. Experience owning threat modelling and security hardening for front-end products; strong grasp of OWASP and secure coding practices. Track record of originating and shepherding cross-team initiatives or RFCs to adoption. Excellent coaching, mentoring, and leadership skills - with evidence of being a force multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor. Strong problem-solving abilities and strategic thinking. Effective stakeholder management and influencing skills. Comfortable representing Flagstone externally (talks, writing, community engagement) - or keen to start. Agile and Scrum practices experience. How we reward you: At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits: Hybrid working - Spend at least 1 day a week with your team in our collaborative London office Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you. A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods. Around the World scheme - 3 months work from anywhere scheme Mental wellbeing support – Access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill Learning and development – £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role. Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded Medical cash plan - To help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses Life insurance and Income Protection- four times your annual salary for peace of mind Matched pension contributions up to 5% 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days Enhanced Parental Leave – enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay. All are welcome. At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Think this role could suit you? We encourage you to apply, no matter your background. You'll partner with squads, Engineering Team Leads, and Product to identify how technology can solve business challenges and take a long-term view on company value.

You'll also play a crucial role in mentoring and coaching engineers, helping them grow their system design skills and ship robust, scalable solutions. As a technical leader, you'll provide strategic guidance while also contributing hands-on to key projects. This will focus on:

  • Technical Strategy: Set the front-end and mobile technical vision in collaboration with Engineering Team Leads, aligning with wider business objectives.

  • Cross-Squad Leadership: Originate and lead horizontal engineering initiatives across the tribe; author and shepherd RFCs from proposal to adoption.

  • Solution Delivery: Contribute directly to building and maintaining high-quality React and React Native systems while supporting and unblocking other engineers.

  • Resilience & Performance: Design solution-wide UI resilience (graceful degradation, back-pressure, retry strategies) and own performance standards across web and mobile.

  • Quality, Security & Compliance: Own threat modelling and security hardening for tribe front-end products; maintain high standards through code review, secure coding practices, and risk management.

  • Strong system architecture and design skills, with thorough understanding of SOLID principles, TDD, DDD, and software design patterns.

  • Track record of originating and shepherding cross-team initiatives or RFCs to adoption.

  • Excellent coaching, mentoring, and leadership skills - with evidence of being a force multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor.

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and strategic thinking.

  • Effective stakeholder management and influencing skills.

  • Comfortable representing Flagstone externally (talks, writing, community engagement) - or keen to start.

  • Agile and Scrum practices experience.

You also contribute to the maintenance of training programs and content, adapting them for local market needs based on central guidelines and frameworks. This is a competency-based training and safety function.

A note on this role

Medical Education at Neko is growing and its structure is still developing. This is an interim appointment, and the scope described here may change as the wider function takes shape. We will be open with you about any changes as they happen.

Onboarding quality and escalation

  • Ensure clinical operator onboarding is delivered to a high and consistent standard across your region, aligned with central guidelines and member safety requirements.

  • Run the onboarding cycle: confirm incoming starters with Recruitment, allocate trainers, and monitor daily trainee progress, stepping in early where progression is slow.

  • Hold the decision to pass, extend, or offboard a trainee in your region, alongside the Lead Operator team.

  • Act as the regional escalation point for clinical training quality and safety matters, triaging every case on first pass to distinguish a genuine safety risk from a standard performance gap, and seeing it through to closure including structured improvement plans.

Support and coach Clinic Trainers

  • Provide guidance, feedback, and support to Clinic Trainers on training methodology, delivery, and assessment.

  • Hold trainers in your region to one national standard, working with Lead Operators so operational needs are met at the same time.

  • Follow up on trainer performance and development.

  • Support Clinic Trainers in completing Impact Reviews for existing clinical staff in line with Neko’s pillars.

Maintain and adapt training programs

  • Maintain training programs and materials as requested, including Sana content, and adapt them to local market needs while staying aligned with global standards and following approval guidelines.

  • Work from one shared source with your counterpart region rather than maintaining separate regional versions, and flag content gaps and inconsistencies centrally rather than resolving them locally in isolation.

  • Deliver or coordinate key clinical skills training within your region, for example Gen II retrofit training, and provide training-plan input into clinic launches and retrofits.

Monitor training quality and drive improvement

  • Observe training delivery, provide structured feedback, and follow up on what changes as a result.

  • Run regional training audits and benchmarks against the national standard, identifying gaps and putting forward improvement proposals, including corrective action where an audit finding requires it.

  • Oversee trainers’ records of staff competency sign-off. No operator works unsupervised on a new device until sign-off is confirmed.

  • Feed hiring and training trends back to Recruitment so screening improves from what is seen downstream in training.

Partner across the business

  • Work closely with clinic leadership and relevant support functions so training meets operational needs as well as the clinical standard, and act as a regional training voice with Recruitment, clinic leads, and cluster management, syncing regularly to stay aligned nationally.

  • Work closely with Clinical Development, participating in product launch handovers and acting as the educational link for your region, including developing training materials for new devices and SOPs when requested and supporting rollout to trainers and operators on the ground.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Healthcare professional with at least two years of clinical experience.

  • Significant post-registration experience in a fast-paced, high-volume clinical setting.

  • Demonstrated clinical leadership, formal or informal.

  • Existing trainer or competency sign-off experience within a Neko clinic, or equivalent clinical procedure competency such as phlebotomy or ECG.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing clinical teams or trainers, including performance management across multiple sites.

  • Track record in competency-based training and assessment.

  • Experience developing or scaling training frameworks to support clinic expansion.

  • Cross-functional collaboration with Recruitment, Operations, or Education teams.

  • A postgraduate certification in a specialist clinical area or in leadership.

Key competencies

  • Strong communication and a coaching mindset

  • Sound clinical judgement under ambiguity

  • A collaborative approach with operators, clinic leads, and trainers

  • Adaptability to new processes and policies

  • Attention to detail in competency checks and training materials

  • Organisational skills across multiple concurrent onboarding cycles

  • A proactive, problem-solving approach to gaps in knowledge or process

Working conditions

  • This role carries protected training capacity on a fixed weekly structure, with a minimum of one scanning day so you remain clinically current and credible with the operators you train.

  • A minimum trial or shadow period applies before full sign-off authority is confirmed, given the clinical safety responsibilities of the role.

  • This is a hands-on regional role with regular travel across your clinic cluster.

About Us 

We are passionate industry experts in the property risk, compliance and safety management industry providing our leading end-to-end solution QUOODA – A platform for property owners and managers to maintain and manage a single source of truth for their complete property portfolio, covering commercial, residential, education, health, financial, tech, and telecoms sectors. 

Our platform is used by over 8000 users across trusted industry leaders and is responsible for managing several of the UK's most iconic buildings, such as London's O2 Arena, The Shard, One Blackfriars, and The Cheese Grater to name just a few. 

The goal of QUOODA is to make it quicker and easier to manage property risk and compliance, providing key information at your fingertips in real-time covering Health & Safety, Fire Safety, Environmental impact, Asset Management, Work Permits and more. 

 

The Team 

Our team is focused on delivering an industry leading platform for our users and providing them with the right features to simplify their tasks. To do this, the team is fully cross-functional and follows agile best practices in a highly collaborative environment - Taking ownership of the platform architecture, infrastructure, and application lifecycle following the 'Build It, Ship It, Own It' philosophy.  

We currently have several teams made up of engineers, testers, and product owners, and are expanding these as we move closer to our scalability and growth targets. This is an exciting time to join our team, as there are great opportunities to make your mark and influence how we do things as we progress with our expansion. 

 

The Role 

As Head of Product, you are the voice, validator and external face of QUOODA. Engineering owns what gets built and why; you bring the customer and commercial judgement they need to make those decisions well, and you are accountable for ensuring the product meets the bar before it reaches customers. Day to day, your closest working relationships are with the CTO and Director of Engineering: you keep them unblocked, informed and well-connected to the commercial and customer context they need. You are the product's spokesperson externally to customers, to sales and new business, and to customer success and you facilitate a direct, unfiltered relationship between engineering and the wider business. You do not sit in the middle: you remove friction, surface context, and validate outcomes. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

 

Product direction and voice 

  • Set and communicate product strategy. Curate and communicate the QUOODA v2 roadmap, reflecting engineering decisions and ensuring the rationale is clearly articulated to the business and market. 
  • Be the spokesperson for QUOODA. Represent the product internally and externally through demos, briefings, webinars, customer councils, sales conversations and analyst or prospect engagements. 
  • Work closely with the CTO and Director of Engineering. Be their primary point of contact for commercial and customer context. Keep them informed of business priorities, market signals and customer feedback so they can make well-grounded decisions without being pulled into business-facing meetings themselves. Flag blockers, misalignments and communication gaps early. 
  • Facilitate prioritisation. Facilitate prioritisation conversations between engineering, commercial and customers. Bring domain and customer context to those decisions, and ensure engineering has what it needs to make well-informed calls. 

Commercial, customer success and sales partnership 

  • Enable sales and new business. Equip the commercial team with messaging, positioning, demo narratives and answers to the hard questions, so they can win against incumbents and triple our customer base by 2030. 
  • Partner with customer success. Translate adoption signals, support themes and renewal risk into product decisions, and give CS the roadmap clarity they need to retain and grow accounts. 

The v1-to-v2 migration 

  • Support engineering in leading the migration of 70 customers from QUOODA v1 to v2. Own the customer-facing communication and experience of the migration. Be the named, accountable point of contact for customers throughout the transition, ensuring engineering has the business and customer context needed to sequence and execute it well. 
  • Surface migration risk to engineering. Ensure engineering has unfiltered customer insight to inform their parity decisions. Own the customer-facing communication of each change — what is different, why, and what support is available, once engineering has made those calls. 
  • Lead the UAT process for QUOODA v2. Be the primary voice from the customer and business perspective on whether the product is ready. Sign off that it meets the bar commercially and functionally in partnership with engineering who hold the technical quality bar. The go/no-go decision is a shared call, and it is explicit. 
  • Curate the backlog of known issues. Turn five years of accumulated, hard-won knowledge about v1's gaps into clear intent for v2. 

Working in an AI-native SDLC 

  • Surface context, not tickets. Surface customer problems, commercial outcomes and real-world constraints in a form that is immediately useful to engineers and AI agents. The goal is to enrich engineering's intent, not to originate it. 
  • Represent the product-engineering model externally. Help customers, partners and the wider business understand how our product-engineering model works and why it produces better outcomes. Engineering owns the operating model itself; your role is to make it legible and credible to the outside world. 

 

Requirements  

 

Essential 

  • Demonstrable product leadership experience in B2B / enterprise SaaS, ideally with a complex, configurable platform. 
  • A credible, confident external presence, comfortable being the face of a product with customers, prospects, sales and CS. 
  • Strong commercial instinct: you understand how product decisions drive pipeline, win rates, retention and growth. 
  • Experience owning a major product transition, migration or re-platforming with a live customer base. 
  • Fluency with (or genuine enthusiasm to embrace) an AI-native, agentic software development lifecycle: working alongside AI coding agents, expressing intent rather than writing exhaustive specs, and evaluating AI-built software. 

 

Highly desirable 

  • Regulated domain experience, ideally in GRC, risk, compliance, audit, or adjacent regulated enterprise software. 
  • Familiarity with API-first, cloud-native product architectures. 
  • Hands-on comfort with AI tooling: prototyping, prompting, and defining evaluations to assess output quality. 
  • Experience in a private-equity backed or high-growth scale-up environment. 

 

Benefits 

  • Competitive salary (depending on experience). 
  • 25 days annual leave (excluding UK bank holidays). 
  • 5% Matched company pension. 
  • Vitality private health insurance (includes Vitality membership). 
  • 4x salary life cover. 
  • Perk Pal retail discounts. 
  • Regular virtual and in-person social events. 

 

If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for writing high-scale, secure, cloud native software, this is an exciting opportunity to grow and help shape the future of our product, platform, and culture.  

 

Sustainware is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

source_record.description:
About Us 

We are passionate industry experts in the property risk, compliance and safety management industry providing our leading end-to-end solution QUOODA – A platform for property owners and managers to maintain and manage a single source of truth for their complete property portfolio, covering commercial, residential, education, health, financial, tech, and telecoms sectors. 

Our platform is used by over 8000 users across trusted industry leaders and is responsible for managing several of the UK's most iconic buildings, such as London's O2 Arena, The Shard, One Blackfriars, and The Cheese Grater to name just a few. 

The goal of QUOODA is to make it quicker and easier to manage property risk and compliance, providing key information at your fingertips in real-time covering Health & Safety, Fire Safety, Environmental impact, Asset Management, Work Permits and more. 

 

The Team 

Our team is focused on delivering an industry leading platform for our users and providing them with the right features to simplify their tasks. To do this, the team is fully cross-functional and follows agile best practices in a highly collaborative environment - Taking ownership of the platform architecture, infrastructure, and application lifecycle following the 'Build It, Ship It, Own It' philosophy.  

We currently have several teams made up of engineers, testers, and product owners, and are expanding these as we move closer to our scalability and growth targets. This is an exciting time to join our team, as there are great opportunities to make your mark and influence how we do things as we progress with our expansion. 

 

The Role 

As Head of Product, you are the voice, validator and external face of QUOODA. Engineering owns what gets built and why; you bring the customer and commercial judgement they need to make those decisions well, and you are accountable for ensuring the product meets the bar before it reaches customers. Day to day, your closest working relationships are with the CTO and Director of Engineering: you keep them unblocked, informed and well-connected to the commercial and customer context they need. You are the product's spokesperson externally to customers, to sales and new business, and to customer success and you facilitate a direct, unfiltered relationship between engineering and the wider business. You do not sit in the middle: you remove friction, surface context, and validate outcomes. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

 

Product direction and voice 

  • Set and communicate product strategy. Curate and communicate the QUOODA v2 roadmap, reflecting engineering decisions and ensuring the rationale is clearly articulated to the business and market. 
  • Be the spokesperson for QUOODA. Represent the product internally and externally through demos, briefings, webinars, customer councils, sales conversations and analyst or prospect engagements. 
  • Work closely with the CTO and Director of Engineering. Be their primary point of contact for commercial and customer context. Keep them informed of business priorities, market signals and customer feedback so they can make well-grounded decisions without being pulled into business-facing meetings themselves. Flag blockers, misalignments and communication gaps early. 
  • Facilitate prioritisation. Facilitate prioritisation conversations between engineering, commercial and customers. Bring domain and customer context to those decisions, and ensure engineering has what it needs to make well-informed calls. 

Commercial, customer success and sales partnership 

  • Enable sales and new business. Equip the commercial team with messaging, positioning, demo narratives and answers to the hard questions, so they can win against incumbents and triple our customer base by 2030. 
  • Partner with customer success. Translate adoption signals, support themes and renewal risk into product decisions, and give CS the roadmap clarity they need to retain and grow accounts. 

The v1-to-v2 migration 

  • Support engineering in leading the migration of 70 customers from QUOODA v1 to v2. Own the customer-facing communication and experience of the migration. Be the named, accountable point of contact for customers throughout the transition, ensuring engineering has the business and customer context needed to sequence and execute it well. 
  • Surface migration risk to engineering. Ensure engineering has unfiltered customer insight to inform their parity decisions. Own the customer-facing communication of each change — what is different, why, and what support is available, once engineering has made those calls. 
  • Lead the UAT process for QUOODA v2. Be the primary voice from the customer and business perspective on whether the product is ready. Sign off that it meets the bar commercially and functionally in partnership with engineering who hold the technical quality bar. The go/no-go decision is a shared call, and it is explicit. 
  • Curate the backlog of known issues. Turn five years of accumulated, hard-won knowledge about v1's gaps into clear intent for v2. 

Working in an AI-native SDLC 

  • Surface context, not tickets. Surface customer problems, commercial outcomes and real-world constraints in a form that is immediately useful to engineers and AI agents. The goal is to enrich engineering's intent, not to originate it. 
  • Represent the product-engineering model externally. Help customers, partners and the wider business understand how our product-engineering model works and why it produces better outcomes. Engineering owns the operating model itself; your role is to make it legible and credible to the outside world. 

 

Requirements  

 

Essential 

  • Demonstrable product leadership experience in B2B / enterprise SaaS, ideally with a complex, configurable platform. 
  • A credible, confident external presence, comfortable being the face of a product with customers, prospects, sales and CS. 
  • Strong commercial instinct: you understand how product decisions drive pipeline, win rates, retention and growth. 
  • Experience owning a major product transition, migration or re-platforming with a live customer base. 
  • Fluency with (or genuine enthusiasm to embrace) an AI-native, agentic software development lifecycle: working alongside AI coding agents, expressing intent rather than writing exhaustive specs, and evaluating AI-built software. 

 

Highly desirable 

  • Regulated domain experience, ideally in GRC, risk, compliance, audit, or adjacent regulated enterprise software. 
  • Familiarity with API-first, cloud-native product architectures. 
  • Hands-on comfort with AI tooling: prototyping, prompting, and defining evaluations to assess output quality. 
  • Experience in a private-equity backed or high-growth scale-up environment. 

 

Benefits 

  • Competitive salary (depending on experience). 
  • 25 days annual leave (excluding UK bank holidays). 
  • 5% Matched company pension. 
  • Vitality private health insurance (includes Vitality membership). 
  • 4x salary life cover. 
  • Perk Pal retail discounts. 
  • Regular virtual and in-person social events. 

 

If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for writing high-scale, secure, cloud native software, this is an exciting opportunity to grow and help shape the future of our product, platform, and culture.  

 

Sustainware is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. What you'll do?

As a Software Engineer at Deliveroo, your individual work contributes to achieving goals in and across your team. While you will work with your team and you may lead projects, some of your work will contribute outside of your direct remit. You will report to managers and group leads and together deliver the results.

  • You will improve code structure, have an impact on architecture, and review code of any scope produced by your team.
  • You'll aim to simplify the maintenance and operation of production systems, visibility, operational readiness, and health of your team's systems.

Collaboration & Leadership:

  • As well as leading from the front regarding technical execution, you'll build relationships with other engineering teams and, identify collaboration opportunities.

  • You will take an active role in the hiring process and conducting engineering interviews. This will also extend to the current team where you will support the personal growth of colleagues, encouraging efficiency in their roles.

We want to emphasise that we don't expect you to meet all of the below but would love you to have experience in some of these areas.

  • Experience with Go and/or Python 
  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • Experience with web architecture at scale (20krpm and above)

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage.

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!
