cards.announcement: Your mission The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs. The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university. In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model. Tasks and Responsabilities Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas. Engage actively in innovation within the area(s) of knowledge to update teaching and learning methodologies and educational technology in collaboration with the Educational Technology team and industry professionals. Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner. Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner. Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus. Conduct course observations as needed, both online and onsite. Collaborate with the Educational Technology team to offer faculty development activities. Support the growing Distance Learning Master’s program in International Relations and Diplomacy. Collaborate with Dean of Institutional Effectiveness to ensure program quality and compliance with all regulations and accreditation requirements. Monitor student outcomes data weekly and to identify students at risk. Work with faculty and student services to design interventions to support their retention and success. Collaborate with Employability team and devise and implement measures and initiatives to boost students’ employability and career success. Coordinate the effective implementation of VLE templates and uniform content within International Relations and Diplomacy offerings. Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders. Any other duties assigned by the Provost, President or Campus Director. Your Profile An earned Doctorate degree in International Relations and Diplomacy or related field from an accredited institution or close to completion. Proven experience and demonstrated excellence in higher education, administration, and industry experience. Academic program design and review and managing faculty and staff. Passion and commitment to student support and success. Knowledge and experience in distant leaning and online instruction. Knowledge of the American and/or French higher education systems is a plus. Wir schaffen Relevanz, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erreichen und zu skalieren.

Sichtbarkeit ist nicht automatisch Relevanz. Reichweite nicht automatisch Wirkung.

WeCreate ist eine Social-First Brand Building Agency für das Interest-Media-Zeitalter. Wir übersetzen Social Signals und Community Insights in Social Strategien, Content-Systeme und messbare Markenwirkung – als strategischer Partner, Campaign Co-Pilot oder operatives Umsetzungsteam. 

Für Marken, die nicht nur stattfinden, sondern kulturell und in ihren Communities relevant sein wollen, suchen wir dich als Senior Creative Strategist (all genders).

Du verbindest strategische Klarheit mit kreativer Führung. Als strategische Stimme von WeCreate entwickelst du die Marken- und Plattformlogik unserer Kund:innen, übersetzt sie in wirksame Content-Systeme und stellst sicher, dass aus einer guten Idee ein konsistenter, relevanter und plattformnativer Content-Output wird.


Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest die strategische und kreative Gesamtausrichtung komplexer Kunden-Mandate von der Social Marken-Positionierung über Plattform- und Kanalstrategien bis zur übergreifenden Content-Systematik und Qualitätssicherung über alle Projektphasen hinweg.

Dabei arbeitest du eigenständig auf Senior-Level, triffst Entscheidungen mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum und kommunizierst sicher mit den Marken-Entscheider:innen. Du führst Creative Reviews, moderierst Sparrings-Formate und gibst Kund:innen sowie internen Teams Orientierung, wenn strategische, kreative oder operative Fragen zusammenkommen.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der integrierten Arbeit mit dem Team: Mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat arbeitest du im WeCreate-Office in Hamburg. Zusätzlich bringst du die notwendige Flexibilität für Produktionen, Workshops, Kundentermine und Offsite-Formate mit auch dann, wenn diese außerhalb deines üblichen Arbeitsortes stattfinden.


Dein Impact bei WeCreate

Du gibst Marken und Teams Richtung. Du sorgst dafür, dass strategische Klarheit nicht in Präsentationen endet, sondern in kreativen Systemen, relevanten Inhalten und konsistenter Markenwirkung sichtbar wird.

Du verbindest die Perspektiven von Kund:innen, Creative Studio, Beratung, Produktion und Plattformen. Dabei bist du mehr als Ideengeber:in. Du entwickelst die Logik hinter der Arbeit, führst durch komplexe Entscheidungen und stellst sicher, dass Qualität über alle Projektphasen hinweg erkennbar bleibt.

Als Senior Creative Strategist stärkst du nicht nur einzelne Kundenprojekte, sondern auch die strategische und kreative Kompetenz von WeCreate als Organisation.


Das erwartet dich:

  • Strategische und kreative Gesamtverantwortung: Du führst komplexe Kunden-Mandate ganzheitlich von digitaler Markenpositionierung, Plattform- und Kanalstrategie bis zur kreativen Leitidee und belastbaren Umsetzungslogik.
  • Seniorige Kunden- und Teamführung: Du präsentierst Strategien und Kreativkonzepte überzeugend, moderierst Sparrings-Formate und führst interdisziplinäre Teams zu klaren, tragfähigen Entscheidungen.
  • Creative Strategy und Narrative Systems: Du entwickelst kulturell relevante Leitideen, Narrative und Content-Systeme, die über Plattformen, Formate und Touchpoints hinweg funktionieren.
  • Qualitäts- und Entscheidungsführung: Du sicherst die strategische und kreative Qualität von der Aufgabenstellung bis zum finalen Output, gibst präzises Feedback und erkennst früh, wenn Idee, Marke und Plattformlogik auseinanderlaufen.
  • Playbooks, Standards und fachliches Sparring: Du entwickelst verbindliche Leitplanken für das Creative Studio und bist ein:e erfahrene:r Sparringspartner:in für Kund:innen sowie Creative-, Strategy- und Beratungsteams.
  • Coaching und Wissensaufbau: Du teilst dein Wissen aktiv, coachst Kolleg:innen und stärkst nicht nur einzelne Arbeiten, sondern auch die strategische und kreative Arbeitsweise des Teams.
  • Systemische Zusammenarbeit und Weiterentwicklung: Du arbeitest eng mit Social-, Creator-, Community-, Production- und Paid-Teams zusammen, begleitest relevante Produktionen und Offsites und entwickelst interne Prozesse sowie KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen weiter. Dafür bringst du Reise- und Terminflexibilität mit.


Das bringst du mit:

Das sind deine Kernkompetenzen

  • Du kannst komplexe Marken- und Business-Herausforderungen in klare strategische Positionierungen, kreative Leitideen und umsetzbare Content-Systeme übersetzen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der strategischen und kreativen Gesamtverantwortung für anspruchsvolle Kunden-Mandate, Kampagnen oder Markenaufgaben.

  • Du kannst Plattform- und Kanalstrategien entwickeln und mit einer übergreifenden Content-Systematik verbinden.

  • Du präsentierst komplexe Strategien sicher vor Entscheider:innen und auf C-Level und kannst unterschiedliche Stakeholder zu klaren Entscheidungen führen.

  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Marken, Content, Plattformkultur und gesellschaftliche sowie kulturelle Signale.

  • Du kannst kreative Qualität über Konzept, Briefing, Produktion und finalen Output hinweg sichern und Feedback präzise, konstruktiv und verbindlich formulieren.

  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, Playbooks, Standards oder Leitplanken zu entwickeln und Wissen in Teams wirksam zu vermitteln.


So arbeitest du

  • Du denkst strategisch und kreativ zugleich und verlierst dabei weder die Marke noch die Plattform oder die Umsetzbarkeit aus dem Blick.

  • Du triffst Entscheidungen eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und schaffst Orientierung, wenn Anforderungen komplex oder noch nicht vollständig geklärt sind.

  • Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch sowie sicher auf Englisch.

  • Du arbeitest gerne integriert mit anderen Disziplinen und weißt, dass die beste Arbeit selten am eigenen Schreibtisch entsteht.

  • Du bist bereit, mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat im Hamburger Office zu arbeiten und für Produktionen, Workshops sowie Offsite-Formate flexibel vor Ort teilzunehmen.

  • Du hast Freude daran, Wissen zu teilen, Kolleg:innen fachlich zu coachen und strategische sowie kreative Arbeitsweisen gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln.


Das bekommst du bei uns:

Flexibilität mit Verbindung

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit unserem Office in Hamburg als Team-Hub

  • Mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat gemeinsames Arbeiten im Office für integrierte Teamarbeit

  • Flexibles Arbeiten von zuhause und wenn du Lust auf einen Perspektivwechsel hast, nach Absprache zeitweise aus dem Ausland

  • Flexibilität für Produktionen, Workshops, Kundentermine und Offsite-Formate

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine Arbeitsweise, die zu deinem Alltag passt

  • Freie Wahl deiner Hardware


Benefits, die dir wirklich etwas bringen

  • Gemeinsame Events und Workations, weil gute Zusammenarbeit nicht nur im Kalender entsteht

  • Wahlweise Zuschuss zum ÖPNV-Ticket, Probonio-Gutschein oder Urban Sports Club

  • Bagel-Frühstück im Office für einen gemeinsamen Start in den Tag


Und sonst?

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, viel Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen in deine Expertise

  • Eine steile Lernkurve – ohne Dauer-Überstunden als vermeintliches Karriereprogramm

  • Raum, eine wachsende Agentur und unsere Arbeitsweisen aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Flache Hierarchien sowie ein respektvoller, offener Umgang miteinander


Hinweis zur Anstellung:

Die Stelle ist zunächst auf zwei Jahre befristet – mit Option auf Verlängerung bzw. Übernahme in ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis.

cards.announcement: Role description As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation. You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track. This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on. Your Mission Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management. Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.

You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track. 

This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on.


Your Mission

Odaseva provides enterprise data management and security solutions that help organizations exercise sovereignty over their critical data.
Companies representing 10% of global market capitalization trust Odaseva, including Schneider Electric, Volkswagen and Robert Half.
Its Excalibur Data Platform enables customers to protect, secure, move, and use data and code independently of application vendors.
The platform supports complex and high-volume use cases, including backup, archiving, zero-copy, BCDR & High Availability, data federation, and semantic AI orchestration.
Customer-controlled end-to-end encryption raises the bar for enterprise security.
With 11 patents, Odaseva manages 50 trillion records and supports 100 million users. 

Your Role

You will join a dynamic Finance team of 7 people in an environment driven by continuous growth and international development.

Reporting directly to the Senior Director, you will play a key role in ensuring accounting accuracy while actively contributing to key projects and transformation initiatives.

In this role, you will maintain accounting operations on NetSuite for 6 international entities and participate in group consolidation processes.

We are looking for someone with strong technical accounting expertise combined with an appetite for change, eager to drive or participate in major strategic projects within a scaling company.


Key Responsibilities

  • Accounting & Treasury Management:

  • Post bank entries and perform daily/monthly bank reconciliations.

  • Manage vendor invoices via our digital processing tool, directing them through approval workflows.

  • Prepare payment runs, perform accounts payable reconciliation, and manage vendor follow-ups/relations.

  • Perform accounts receivable matching and reconciliation.

  • Perform payroll accounting entry integration.

  • Apply analytical accounting principles across your perimeter.

  • Asset Management, Tax & Group Reporting:

  • Perform fixed asset accounting, tracking, and reconciliation.

  • Prepare monthly closing operations (cut-off entries, accruals, VAT, exchange variance analysis, etc.).

  • Prepare French tax declarations (DAS2, VAT, and other local taxes).

  • Manage US Sales Tax compliance

  • Contribute to monthly financial reporting and participate in the Group consolidation process.

  • Ensure daily maintenance of accounting ledgers in compliance with company rules, accounting standards, quality, and deadlines.

  • Support annual statutory audit processes.

  • Projects & Change Management:

  • Actively lead or participate in high-impact finance projects, process automation, and system enhancements.

  • Embrace and drive change to support the scaling of our international finance organization.


    • Required Qualifications

  • Experience & Technical Skills:

  • Degree in Accounting or Finance (e.g., DCG, DSCG, or equivalent).

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar accounting role within an international group or fast-paced environment.

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite (familiarity with CSV imports, FAM module, Saved Searches, and multi-currency/multi-entity setups) is required.

  • Strong technical accounting expertise (Local GAAP, closing operations, fixed assets, French taxes).

  • Soft Skills & Mindset:

  • Appetite for Change & Project-Driven: You thrive in scaling, evolving environments and enjoy driving or contributing to major transformation projects.

  • Rigor & Organization: You believe structured methods and precision are the keys to operational success.

  • Language: Professional English proficiency (written and spoken) to interact effectively within a global team and environment.


    • Where you'll be
  • Based in Paris (75002), France.
  • Hybrid: 3 days in the office / 2 days remote work.
  • Full time permanent contract position.
    • Who We Are
    At Odaseva, we believe in fostering an inclusive, supportive work environment where talented people can innovate and grow. Our culture is built on being smart, humble, hardworking, and above all—collaborative.
     
    Our core values define who we are: Trust, Customer Centricity, Engagement, Excellence, Continuous Innovation, and Teamwork.
     
    Inclusive & Diverse – We champion equality and embrace diversity.
    Supportive & Collaborative – A team of smart, kind professionals who uplift each other through teamwork, not competition.
    Excellence with a Casual Touch – High professional standards in a relaxed, approachable work culture.
    Impact-Driven – A place where you can truly make a difference and advance your career.
    Innovators in Data & Cloud – Leading the way in cutting-edge technology and solutions.
    Competitive & Rewarding – Offering industry-leading compensation and benefits.
    Truly Global – With offices in Paris, San Francisco, Sydney, and London, and a worldwide presence.
    Flexible Work Environment – We support a hybrid, flexible office culture.
     
    At Odaseva, we are an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We consider all applicants for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

cards.announcement: IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention . Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability. The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France , and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries.   This position is based in Berlin/Munich, Germany or Rennes, France.      IDnow is looking for  Product Owner – Trust Services (f/m/d) to own the product direction, backlog and outcomes for a technical product area within IDnow’s Digital Identity and Trust Services portfolio. Working with a dedicated Scrum Team, this role turns customer, operational, regulatory and engineering input into a clear product goal, an ordered backlog and valuable, usable increments that can be released and operated safely.   The most critical aspect of this role is serving as the accountable product interface between the Trust Services domain and Engineering: understanding the system boundaries, APIs, integrations, data flows and non-functional requirements well enough to make sound trade-offs, remove ambiguity and ensure that security, privacy, resilience, auditability and regulatory obligations are built into the product from the beginning.   Key Responsibilities   Own the product goal, roadmap and backlog : prioritize by value, risk, dependencies and learning; keep decisions transparent.   Drive Scrum outcomes : lead refinement, support Planning and Reviews, clarify Sprint Goals, and use delivery metrics to improve flow.   Turn needs into buildable requirements : define user/system journeys, domain concepts, business rules, APIs, data states, errors, acceptance criteria and testable non-functional requirements – without over-prescribing implementation.   Partner on solution quality : work with Engineering, Architecture, Security, QA and Operations on service boundaries, technical debt, scalability, performance, availability, resilience, observability, incidents and operational readiness.   Own data, integration and lifecycle design : govern identity and audit-data flows, access, protection and retention; shape secure, interoperable APIs, including authentication, encryption, versioning, error handling and documentation.   Support releases and continuous improvement : define readiness, migrations, cutovers, deprecation, feature flags and rollback; participate in incident reviews and prioritize recurring quality, security and operational issues.   Translate regulation into product decisions : apply eIDAS2, EUDI Wallet, QES, QEAA/EAA, identity-proofing and trust-service requirements with Compliance, Legal, Risk and Trust Services SMEs, tracking adoption, reliability, quality, delivery flow and compliance readiness.   Collaborate across functions: align with Scrum Team s , Engineering leadership, Architecture, Security, SRE/Operations, Trust Services, Product, Compliance/Legal/Risk/Data Protection, Commercial and Customer Success, as well as relevant partners, relying parties and standards bodies.   Preferred Experience   4+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Technical Product Management, Business Analysis or similar roles in software and service delivery, including direct responsibility for backlog quality and product outcomes.   Hands-on experience working in Scrum or a comparable agile delivery model: ability to define a Product Goal, order a Product Backlog, write clear product backlog items, set acceptance criteria, participate in refinement and reviews, and make timely scope and priority decisions.   Strong technical fluency in modern software products and integrations, including REST APIs, JSON/Open API, authentication and authorization, OAuth2/OIDC concepts, webhooks or event streams, data models, service boundaries, API lifecycle and backward-compatible change.   Demonstrable experience working with regulated software and services, translating regulatory, security, privacy and audit requirements into actionable product requirements and delivery decisions, while balancing compliance, customer value, usability, scalability and time to market.   Practical understanding of secure software and service delivery: threat and risk thinking, software security, access control, encryption, secrets and key management, vulnerability handling, logging/monitoring, incident response, resilience and software supply-chain considerations.   Practical understanding of data lifecycle and privacy-by-design for identity and trust services, including data minimization, purpose limitation, sensitive evidence, retention and deletion, evidence, archival, data residency, audit trails and access transparency.   Ability to work with Engineering on system-level trade-offs without needing to be the implementing engineer, and to distinguish product decisions, architecture decisions, implementation choices, technical debt and operational risk.   Experience with service operations and lifecycle management, including release readiness, SLO or service-quality thinking, incident triage, post-incident learning, customer-impact assessment, migration, deprecation and support enablement.   Experience in regulated industries (e.g., financial services, telecom, public sector, payments, KYC/AML, digital identity, electronic signatures, PKI or trust services) is a strong plus, as is familiarity with eIDAS2, EUDI Wallets, ETSI standards or QTSP operating models.   Perks & Benefits    Health & Wellbeing: Use your full access to the mental health platform nilo, including 1on1 sessions.    We value personal and professional development: make full use of Udemy, our training platform with 24/7 access and unlimited licences.    We make your remote work comfy: we provide support on equipment and offer flexible working hours.    We value collaboration & love to come together: regular onsite gatherings, internal initiatives and summer parties to connect across teams.    May your family require your attention or other reasons apply: use the benefits of our parental leave policy or our sabbatical programme.    In addition to the perks & benefits above, we offer specific benefits that differ between our locations.       IDnow applies the principles of non-discrimination and equality: We strive to establish, maintain, and promote an open and inclusive recruitment process and working environment by respecting the principles of equal opportunities. Including but not limited to: race or ethnic origin, religion or convictions, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, disability, age, or sexual orientation. source_record.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As Technical Writer, you will own the documentation of Alta Ares' product suite — producing the manuals, user guides, interface specifications, and operational references that enable military operators, system integrators, and institutional clients to deploy and use Alta Ares' platforms with confidence.

In defence, documentation is not a nice-to-have. A military operator in a contested environment cannot call the helpdesk. A procurement officer reviewing an acceptance package expects documentation that is precise, complete, and unambiguous. Your work is the last line of clarity between a complex, cutting-edge system and the person who has to operate it under pressure.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and the Pre & Post Sales team — translating deeply technical content into structured, accessible, operationally relevant documentation. This is a high-craft, high-ownership role in a company where the quality of your writing directly affects operational outcomes.

Product Documentation — User Guides & Operator Manuals

  • Own the full suite of end-user documentation for Alta Ares' product portfolio: operator manuals, quick-start guides, field reference cards, and system overviews

  • Write clear, structured, and operationally grounded documentation for military end-users — adapting tone, level of detail, and format to the audience (drone operator, system administrator, field commander)

  • Develop and maintain documentation for each product line: ISR module, C-UAS platform, MLOps stack, GCS interface, and ground equipment

  • Produce multilingual documentation in English and French — ensuring accuracy and consistency across both versions

  • Maintain a versioned documentation library aligned with each product release and firmware update

Interface & System Specifications

  • Document software interfaces, system architectures, and hardware integration specifications in collaboration with Engineering

  • Produce interface control documents (ICDs), system description documents (SDDs), and integration guides for system integrators and institutional clients

  • Translate engineering schematics, API references, and architecture diagrams into human-readable specifications accessible to non-specialist audiences

  • Maintain up-to-date configuration guides, parameter references, and software release notes for each product version

  • Support the Engineering team in documenting internal technical standards and development guidelines

Operational & Field Documentation

  • Develop field-ready documentation adapted to operational environments: laminated quick-reference cards, checklists, and compact field guides

  • Produce pre-flight checklists, maintenance procedures, and troubleshooting guides for UAV platforms and C-UAS systems

  • Create training materials and operational scenario guides for use during client onboarding, field demonstrations, and exercises

  • Ensure all field documentation meets the usability requirements of military audiences: clear hierarchy, unambiguous language, and actionable step-by-step instructions

Documentation Lifecycle & Quality Management

  • Own the documentation lifecycle end-to-end: planning, drafting, review, validation, versioning, and publication

  • Establish and enforce documentation standards across Alta Ares: style guide, terminology glossary, formatting conventions, and review processes

  • Coordinate review cycles with Engineering, Product, and Pre & Post Sales teams — ensuring technical accuracy before publication

  • Manage the documentation repository in Notion and ensure all documents are findable, versioned, and access-controlled appropriately

  • Track and incorporate feedback from field deployments, client reviews, and post-sales observations into documentation updates

Client-Facing Delivery Documentation

  • Produce documentation packages for client deliverables: acceptance test procedures, delivery dossiers, and contractual documentation requirements

  • Support the preparation of responses to RFP documentation requirements and compliance matrices

  • Contribute to the development of training packages for institutional clients and partner integrators

  • Ensure client-facing documentation meets applicable defence documentation standards and contractual specifications

Candidate Profile - Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in technical writing — with a strong focus on product documentation, user manuals, or operational guides

  • Prior experience documenting hardware-software integrated systems — mandatory : you must be comfortable with complex, multi-component products

  • Background in defence, aerospace, robotics, deeptech, or dual-use is a strong plus — you understand the operational context in which your documentation will be used

  • Experience producing documentation for non-specialist end-users (operators, field technicians) as well as technical audiences (engineers, integrators)

  • Prior exposure to documentation lifecycle management and versioning in a product environment

source_record.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

About the Role
We are building next-generation interceptor drones and are looking for a Senior Jet Engine Design Engineer to lead the development of small-scale jet propulsion systems (12–25 kg thrust class), from concept to flight-ready hardware. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a fast-moving startup environment where speed and iteration matter more than lengthy upfront studies.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop new small jet engines (12–25 kg thrust range) in-house, optimized for very low production cost

  • Own the aerodynamic design of turbine components, balancing performance, manufacturability, and cost

  • Design a large portion of the turbine for metal 3D printing (additive manufacturing), leveraging design-for-AM principles to reduce part count, weight, and cost

  • Work closely with 3D printing operations to define printable geometries, tolerances, post-processing, and qualify parts for flight use

  • Drive a rapid, fail-fast iteration process: build, test, learn, and redesign quickly rather than relying on long analytical phases before prototyping

  • Integrate propulsion systems into airframes such as flying wings and other interceptor drone configurations, working with aerostructures and systems teams

  • Apply and enforce design rules for operation in extreme environments (cold and hot climates, rain, humidity, icing conditions) to ensure engine reliability across the full operational envelope

  • Contribute to engine testing (bench and flight), performance validation, and continuous design improvement

Candidate Profile:

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in jet engine / gas turbine design, with a proven track record of having designed and delivered engine models (not just component-level work)

  • Strong hands-on experience with small jet engines in the 12–25 kg thrust class

  • Solid global understanding of jet engine architecture: compressor, combustor, turbine, fuel system, controls, and their interactions

  • Experience designing turbine/engine components for metal additive manufacturing (DfAM), and practical knowledge of metal 3D printing processes and constraints

  • Comfortable working in a rapid-iteration, fail-fast development culture rather than a traditional long-cycle aerospace process

  • Experience integrating propulsion systems into airframes (flying wing or similar unconventional platforms is a strong plus)

  • Knowledge of design requirements for extreme operating environments (temperature extremes, precipitation, icing)

  • Ability to work autonomously in a small, fast-paced startup team, wearing multiple hats when needed

Nice to Have

  • Experience with UAV/drone propulsion specifically (vs. manned aviation)

  • Familiarity with low-cost manufacturing strategies for defense/dual-use hardware

  • Prior startup or skunkworks experience

cards.announcement: Product Manager – Innovation & Design Location: Paris (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent Imaginez et construisez des produits qui répondent aux vrais besoins des utilisateurs et transforment durablement les services financiers.   Capco recherche des Product Managers pour accompagner les acteurs majeurs des services financiers et de l'énergie dans la conception de produits utiles à leurs clients et créateurs de valeur pour leur organisation. Au sein de notre capability Tech, Product & Engineering , vous intégrerez des équipes pluridisciplinaires réunissant Product Managers, ingénieurs, développeurs et experts métiers. Votre rôle sera de comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs, identifier les bonnes problématiques à résoudre et transformer ces insights en produits simples, viables et performants. Vous intégrerez également de manière pragmatique les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés dans vos méthodes de travail pour accélérer la recherche, l’analyse et l’expérimentation, tout en conservant le jugement humain au cœur des décisions produit.   Vos responsabilités   Travailler avec des équipes produit pluridisciplinaires pour identifier les problématiques utilisateurs prioritaires et concevoir des solutions à la fois désirables, viables et techniquement réalisables. Intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie produit, de la discovery et de la recherche utilisateur jusqu’au lancement, à la mesure de la performance et à l’optimisation continue. Combiner études de marché, recherche qualitative, données quantitatives et comportements observés pour construire une compréhension structurée des utilisateurs et exploiter, lorsque pertinent, des outils d’IA approuvés pour accélérer l’analyse et faire émerger des insights. Intégrer les contraintes propres aux services financiers – réglementation, risques et contrôles, protection des données et viabilité économique – dans les décisions produit. Piloter le produit par les résultats et la valeur créée pour les utilisateurs et le business, en testant différentes approches plutôt qu’en vous concentrant uniquement sur la production de livrables. Compétences et expériences désirées    Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en Product Management, acquise au sein d’une entreprise technologique ou d’un cabinet de conseil. Une expérience avérée dans la discovery, la conception et le développement de produits de bout en bout, idéalement sur des expériences web et mobiles. Une bonne maîtrise des méthodologies produit – Jobs-to-be-Done, personas, frameworks de priorisation, KANO, Lean Startup – et des méthodes de delivery Agile. Une capacité démontrée à collaborer avec des designers, ingénieurs/développeurs, équipes métiers et parties prenantes, ainsi qu’à traiter des problématiques complexes à partir de données et d'insights structurés. Une bonne connaissance de la banque et des services financiers, associée à une curiosité pour les usages de l’IA et des workflows AI-enabled permettant d'améliorer la qualité, la rapidité ou la pertinence du travail produit, dans un cadre responsable et avec validation humaine. Vous êtes à l’aise pour travailler en français et en anglais dans des environnements internationaux.    Pourquoi rejoindre Capco? Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers. Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 36 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris.  Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution. Notre promesse : accompagner la transformation de nos clients dans un monde en constante mutation – réglementaire, technologique et opérationnel.   • Managed a global program with contributors and learners across multiple regions.

  • Worked closely with Product, Engineering, Science, People, and customer-facing teams.

source_record.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

This is a people-leadership role from day one. You will manage the team — hiring, coaching, performance, growth paths, honest feedback — while staying close to the code: roughly half your time in architecture decisions and the hardest technical problems the team faces, the other half leading your squad. If you are looking for a senior IC role, this is not it.

You will own our Kubernetes product end to end: a metal-to-on-demand platform built on in-house infrastructure, with GPU support for training, inference, and general-purpose compute.

Kubernetes is our product, not just our platform — we run it on infrastructure we own end to end. You will decide how the control plane scales, how GPUs get scheduled, and how quickly a rack of bare metal becomes an on-demand cluster a customer can use. The decisions you make here shape how our infrastructure scales from today's footprint to a gigawatt, and how we turn frontier AI research into production systems used by millions.

This is a role for an engineer who leads from the front because that is where the work is, not because management was the next rung on the ladder.

What You Will Do

  • Design and ship the control plane. You build alongside your team and own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions — scheduling, operators, provisioning, node lifecycle.

  • Grow the engineers, not just the software. You set the standard for ownership, remove the obstacles in their way, and coach them past their comfort zone until the work they ship surprises them.

  • Own the reliability of the Kubernetes control plane. It is the team's headline KPI. You make the calls when it breaks at 3am, and your engineers learn from how you do it.

  • Shrink the distance from metal to on-demand. Provisioning a cluster should be minutes of automation, not weeks of tickets.

  • Partner with Product Managers to set priorities, scope initiatives, and make the technical and business tradeoffs.

  • Own people management for the team: hiring, performance, growth paths, and honest feedback — the leadership work that never becomes someone else's job.

  • Define the team's processes and execution rituals as it grows.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • You have run Kubernetes in anger — and ideally built parts of it: operators, schedulers, controllers. You understand what happens underneath it, and you have worked on Linux directly, not just on managed services that sit on top of it.

  • You have run GPU workloads on Kubernetes, or you are confident you can own that domain fast.

  • You think like a developer who happens to build infrastructure, not an operator who manages it. You write code other engineers depend on.

  • Extensive experience building backend or infrastructure systems.

  • You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

A datacenter is not a cloud until software makes it one. You will lead the team that turns arriving hardware into accepted clusters.

Cabling validation, burn-in, firmware, deployment validation, software stack install — all of it automated, none of it click-ops. Your KPI is time to acceptance: the hours between a rack being physically installed and it serving customer workloads. Across the industry that number is measured in weeks. You will drive it toward days, then hours, as we scale toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe.

This is a founding leadership role at the intersection of hardware and software. Early on it is deliberately hands-on: most of your time in the code and the architecture, some of it on datacenter floors, because the automation has to survive contact with the machines it runs on.

But the job is building and leading a team from day one — hiring your first engineers, coaching them, setting their growth paths, and running the rituals that keep quality high. As the team grows, the balance shifts toward people leadership, and you decide how fast. You shape this new team's charter and set the standard for how every future Mistral datacenter comes online.

  • Build the delivery pipeline in Go: provisioning, configuration, validation, burn-in, network bring-up, software stack install.

  • Build the team from scratch: make the first hires, onboard and coach them, own their performance and growth paths — and set the tooling standards and the playbook every future site reuses.

  • Own time-to-acceptance and drive it down relentlessly — measure it, break it down, kill the slowest step first.

  • Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Hardware Design and Fleet Health — reliability starts at delivery.

  • Handle GPU fleets at scale: H100 and GB200-class nodes, InfiniBand and RoCE fabrics, and the failure modes they bring.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems, with at least 2 years leading engineers — real people leadership: you have hired, coached, and grown engineers, not just set technical direction.

  • Deep Linux: you are comfortable well below the application layer.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • Willing to travel to datacenter sites when the work demands it.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

cards.announcement: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.  The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.  About this team and role: Firefox Enterprise is a new team within Mozilla that is addressing the needs of business and government customers for a secure enterprise browser that gives organizations greater control over their data, policies, and digital infrastructure. We’re now seeking a Strategic Account Manager, Firefox Enterprise to help grow Firefox Enterprise in France . This is a high-impact enterprise sales role for someone who is excited to build deep relationships with customers and help them achieve success using Firefox Enterprise.    What you’ll do:  Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customer accounts Build and maintain strong, long-term client relationships Understand our customer goals, challenges, and business needs  Drive Firefox Enterprise adoption, engagement, and overall satisfaction across the account Manage renewals and proactively address retention risks Coordinate with internal teams (Sales, Support, Product, Solution Engineering) to deliver a seamless customer experience Identify and pursue expansion opportunities within existing accounts, including additional seats, upgraded tiers, or new use cases Track account health, usage, and performance metrics, including forecast reports on retention, renewal and expansion Conduct regular check-ins, business reviews, and success planning with customers Resolve issues and escalate when necessary to ensure timely resolution What you’ll bring:  Significant experience in enterprise SaaS, infrastructure, security, or platform account management, sales, customer support or other customer facing roles Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to establish trust and credibility at all levels of a customer organization Proven track record of supporting customer renewals, retention, and revenue growth Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and French. Must be willing and able to travel within France as needed for the role, with a preference for candidates located in the Paris metro area Must be willing and able to occasionally accommodate collaboration and meetings aligned with U.S. business hours Negotiation and influence skills to support renewals, expansions, and customer advocacy Commitment to our values: Welcoming differences Being relationship-minded Practicing responsible participation Having grit What you’ll get: Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday One-time home office stipend Annual professional development budget Quarterly well-being stipend Considerable paid parental leave Employee referral bonus program Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) About Mozilla  Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm. About Davis Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability. We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital , with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end. The Role You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically. You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself. What you will be working on Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable. Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data. Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage. Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining. Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture. Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time. What We Are Looking For You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you. Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself. Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation. Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture. Nice to have Computer vision and document understanding , images to structured output, OCR, layout extraction, segmentation, geometry extraction, vectorization, raster to vector, image to scene graph, 3D or CAD. Graph and structured scientific data , molecular, protein or scene graphs, meshes, CAD, BIM, 3D geometry, or relational and structured world data. Synthetic worlds and simulation , a structured state to a simulator to a renderer to synthetic images with perfect labels, then a perception model, with an eye on the sim-to-real gap. Foundation models from scratch , real involvement in a large pretraining run, not only fine-tuning. Public evidence of data ownership , lead on a dataset, a Hugging Face release, a dataset card, a technical blog on your pipeline, or a talk on data curation or synthetic data. GIS and geometry , parcels, zoning layers, projections, computational geometry or constrained optimization. Multi-country data , heterogeneous sources, localization and varying rules. Why Join Davis Own the data end to end , from the generator to the pretraining mixture, as the person who defines what the model learns from. Shape a foundation model from scratch , on a structured representation no one else is training on. Work on genuinely hard problems , image to graph, synthetic worlds and large-scale pretraining, with your work reaching clients within days. Competitive salary and meaningful equity , at a founding level, in an early-stage company. Join a world-class team , a mix of AI researchers, engineers and architects backed by world-class VCs. More information about Davis, the team and the market we're going after: Team Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20 , and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle. Today we are a team of twelve : technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar . If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need. Why We Will Win Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated. Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work , AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts. Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability , and parametric tools only check constraints after generation , which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites. Generative AI has the potential to solve this , but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable. This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly. We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we are a team of twelve: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need.

Why We Will Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability, and parametric tools only check constraints after generation, which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable.

This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application.

Objectif du poste : 
 

Nous recherchons un(e) Architecte Technique Salesforce pour accompagner nos clients Grands Comptes dans la conception et l’évolution de leurs plateformes Salesforce.

Vous interviendrez sur des projets de transformation Salesforce dans des environnements exigeants, notamment dans les secteurs du Luxe & Retail, de l’Hospitality et de la Finance, sur des problématiques de transformation, d’intégration et de modernisation des SI.

Vous contribuerez également à l’évolution des architectures vers de nouveaux usages liés à l’IA générative, l’automatisation intelligente et les agents Salesforce.

 

Missions :

 

  • Définir les architectures techniques Salesforce Core adaptées aux enjeux des clients Grands Comptes.
  • Concevoir des solutions robustes, scalables et alignées avec les standards Salesforce.
  • Participer aux phases de cadrage et de conception et challenger les choix techniques.
  • Accompagner les Tech Leads et équipes de développement dans la mise en œuvre.
  • Définir les architectures d’intégration Salesforce / SI : APIs, middleware et systèmes externes.
  • Garantir les enjeux de performance, sécurité, gouvernance et qualité.
  • Contribuer à l’intégration de nouveaux usages liés à l’IA générative et aux agents Salesforce.
  • Réaliser des revues d’architecture et intervenir sur la résolution de problématiques techniques complexes.

Vous disposez d’une expérience significative sur des architectures Salesforce complexes.

Vous maîtrisez l’architecture Salesforce Core, les problématiques de données, sécurité, intégration, performance et gouvernance, ainsi que les principaux mécanismes de développement de la plateforme.

Vous êtes capable de dialoguer aussi bien avec des équipes techniques qu’avec des interlocuteurs clients, de challenger les besoins et de transformer les enjeux métier en solutions techniques pérennes.

Une première expérience sur Agentforce, Claude Force, LLM ou architectures intégrant des services d’IA est fortement appréciée.

Spécialiste en conseil organisationnel, en amélioration des performances commerciales et en optimisation de l'expérience client grâce à l'informatique et à l'IA, VO2 Finance propose une expertise digitale à la fois technologique, méthodologique et sectorielle – incluant le financement, les marchés de capitaux, les opérations front, middle et back office, les systèmes d'information bancaires et la réglementation. CONTEXTE Au sein de l'équipe IT AI Transversal dédiée à la banque de financement et d'investissement (CIB), vous rejoindrez un pôle stratégique au cœur de la transformation IA. L'équipe a pour mission d'équiper les collaborateurs des meilleurs outils IA, de piloter leur adoption et de représenter la CIB au sein des instances de gouvernance IA du Groupe. En tant que Program Lead AI for Tech, vous jouerez un rôle pivot d'interlocuteur privilégié auprès des différentes entités du Groupe sur l'ensemble des sujets IA for Tech. DESCRIPTIF DE MISSION Au quotidien, vous piloterez et animerez la mission autour de deux axes majeurs : 1. Volet PMO & Gouvernance Stratégique : Représenter et préparer : Préparer en amont chaque instance IA for Tech (COPIL, RUN, BUILD, Brainstorming, PI Planning), produire les notes de position CIB, identifier les arbitrages à porter et remonter les alertes. Au sein de l'équipe IT AI Transversal dédiée à la banque de financement et d'investissement (CIB), vous rejoindrez un pôle stratégique au cœur de la transformation IA. L'équipe a pour mission d'équiper les collaborateurs des meilleurs outils IA, de piloter leur adoption et de représenter la CIB au sein des instances de gouvernance IA du Groupe.

En tant que Program Lead AI for Tech, vous jouerez un rôle pivot d'interlocuteur privilégié auprès des différentes entités du Groupe sur l'ensemble des sujets IA for Tech.

 
DESCRIPTIF DE MISSION

Au quotidien, vous piloterez et animerez la mission autour de deux axes majeurs :

1. Volet PMO & Gouvernance Stratégique :

  • Coordonner : Animer la coordination interne en amont et en aval des instances, collecter les contributions des équipes (IT, Métiers, Sécurité, Conformité) et diffuser les décisions.

 

2. Volet Tech, Déploiement & Innovation :

  • Piloter et suivre : Assurer le suivi opérationnel des chantiers IA for Tech impactant la CIB (déploiement des outils, modèle économique, LLM on-premise, stratégie agentique, sécurité des Skills).

  • Participer à la feuille de route : Contribuer directement aux PI Plannings semestriels du Groupe, à la construction de la stratégie agentique CIB et au déploiement souverain des LLMs on-premise.

  • Diffuser la culture Tech & IA : Impulser les nouvelles pratiques (vibe coding, création d'usines AI pour la production de supports/slides, veille continue).

 
Livrable (liste non exhaustive)

  • Notes de position CIB et supports d'arbitrage pour les instances de gouvernance.

  • Synthèses de coordination multi-entités et relevés de décisions.

  • Feuilles de route et dossiers de cadrage sur les chantiers tech (LLM on-premise, stratégie agentique).

  • Matrice de suivi du modèle économique et de la consommation IA.

  • Supports de présentation et livrables à haute valeur ajoutée (usines à slides / AI-generated).

  • Évaluations d'impacts et fiches de conformité/sécurité liées aux usages IA.


Profil recherché 🔎

  • Formation d'ingénieur ou solide diplôme supérieur en informatique/tech (une Grande École type INSA ou un Doctorat/PhD est un vrai plus)

  • 9 à 12 ans d'expérience en conseil, gestion de projet IT ou pilotage de programmes tech complexes multi-entités

  • Expérience en banque/CIB appréciée, mais les profils issus d'autres industries avec une vision enrichissante sont les bienvenus

  • Maîtrise de la gouvernance IA/Tech et du suivi du modèle économique / consommation IA

  • Compréhension des enjeux de déploiement de LLM on-premise, de la stratégie agentique et de la sécurité IA en environnement contraint

  • Excellent relationnel, rigueur et diplomatie face à des interlocuteurs de niveau direction

  • Capacité à produire des livrables de cadrage percutants et forte appétence pour les nouvelles méthodes (vibe coding)

  • Anglais courant obligatoire (niveau C1)

Défendre des arbitrages face au client : configuration standard ou développement spécifique, vision cible ou solution pragmatique, et assumer la recommandation. Répondre aux revues de sécurité et aux questions de due diligence technique ; rédiger des analyses de cause racine en cas d'incident de production. Configuration de la plateforme et données (environ 50 %) Configurer la plateforme InsideBoard via son interface d'administration ou ses API : KPIs (formules, agrégation, fréquences), plans d'action et programmes de coaching, challenges, guidance, sections de profil, champs personnalisés, formulaires, notifications, imports d'utilisateurs, de départements et de tags. Construire et maintenir des workflows d'automatisation n8n : webhooks, tâches planifiées, synthèses générées par IA, pipelines de contenu RAG, alerting d'erreurs centralisé vers Slack. Scripter des opérations de données en Python ou TypeScript : migrations en masse avec discipline dry-run et rollback, audits de licences, rapports d'engagement, échanges Excel/CSV/SFTP avec les DSI clientes. Brancher des fonctionnalités LLM pour les clients : synthèses de performance générées par IA, pipelines OCR, bases de connaissances RAG, conception de prompts d'agents. Le profil recherché Vous n'avez pas besoin de connaître toutes les technologies que nous utilisons. Il vous faut assez de profondeur technique pour superviser une IA qui les connaît : comprendre son plan, poser les bonnes questions, repérer quand elle dérive, et valider le résultat avant qu'il n'atteigne un client. Indispensable Une vraie maîtrise des agents de code IA (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf ou équivalent) : vous savez spécifier une tâche précisément, piloter l'agent, relire sa production avec un œil critique et vérifier le résultat. Vous savez aussi quand ne pas lui faire confiance. Une capacité de contrôle technique : vous lisez un diﬀ ou un log suﬃsamment bien pour comprendre ce qui a changé et pourquoi, vous suivez un appel API de bout en bout, vous vérifiez la cohérence d'une transformation de données et vous testez ce que l'IA a construit avant de livrer. Écrire du code de zéro n'est pas exigé. Une aisance avec les API REST : authentification, pagination, rate limits ; à l'aise avec la plomberie de données JSON/CSV/XLSX. Une excellente communication client en français et en anglais : vous savez animer un atelier, recadrer avec diplomatie et écrire des documents qu'un DSI lira. De la rigueur et de la prudence avec les données de production : dry-runs, plans de rollback,logs. Vous faites mesurer deux fois à l'IA avant toute mise à jour en masse. Un plus Une expérience de développement (TypeScript, Python), utile mais non requise. Une expérience avec n8n, Zapier, Make ou une plateforme d'automatisation similaire. Une exposition aux écosystèmes d'entreprise : Salesforce, Dynamics 365, SAP , SSO. Une expérience d'intégration LLM (API OpenAI/Anthropic/Mistral, RAG, conception de prompts). Un passé en adoption SaaS, conduite du changement ou customer success engineering. Processus de recrutement : Un appel initial de 15 minutes sera programmé avec Shelly dès que votre candidature sera approuvée puis un entretien RH avec Shelly de nouveau. Ensuite, vous aurez un entretien d'une heure pour discuter de vos expériences, motivations et de notre entreprise avec Sébastien Vous rencontrerez votre future manager, Manan , pour discuter plus en détail du rôle, de vos compétences et de ce que nous pouvons vous offrir. Enfin, un appel téléphonique avec Michael, l'un des directeurs d'InsideBoard AI, clôturera le processus. Ce que nous offrons • Une opportunité de travailler dans une entreprise innovante et en pleine croissance. • Un environnement de travail collaboratif et stimulant. • Des possibilités de développement professionnel et de montée en compétences. • Des événements d’équipe réguliers et une culture d’entreprise conviviale.
